## Outcome and scope

SLIs/SLOs, capacity, telemetry/alerts, degraded mode, recovery and runbooks.

Examples, property/model/concurrency/fault/security/contract/performance/recovery tests and evidence artifacts.

## Rollout and acceptance

Stages, health/business gates, abort criteria, approvers and final evidence.
